title: Repair real service credentials in original hosted D observation

Updated hosted runtime unit fixtures and FakeRuntimeHttp to enforce exact service bearer + X-Tenant-Id headers on Reconciliation evaluation and Evolution input-coverage/proposal GETs, verify C_promote does not require D-only credentials, and verify missing D_observe credentials fail closed with DeployedProofError naming the missing variable.

Extended VM runner tests to assert SERVICE_CREDENTIALS mapping, docker exec printenv reads for reconciliation-drift-svc and evolution, private subprocess env propagation, and redaction from phase.log and segment-meta.json.
